title: 第16章 杀狼求追读第17章 朱果
content_zh:
“这山里的异兽，大多都是这赤毛兔。”
他吐槽一声，拎起赤毛兔，丢给了赶过来的老学徒处理。
随后看了一眼脚下的滑雪板，还有不远处的大黑狗，这才对陆沉道：“你研究的这滑雪板还挺好用，加上这二黑敢撵赤毛兔，这次你可立功不小啊。”
“若非师兄箭法百步穿杨，我可抓不住这赤毛兔。”
陆沉笑了笑，谦虚地道。
这段时间，为了狩猎异兽，陆沉抽空制作了几个滑雪板。
滑雪板的速度极快，让他们有了驱赶异兽的速度，而且二黑也帮了大忙。
每次狩猎，都是由二黑前去驱赶，将赤毛兔赶到埋伏圈里，再由众人以滑雪板围堵，最终被楚阔一箭射杀。
靠着这一套，在这短短几天里，他们先后猎杀了六头异兽，其中有五头赤毛兔、外加一头黄纹貂，价值加起来已经有近千两白银。
楚阔心情大好，随后说道：“这样吧，这些赤毛兔，每只分你二十两白银。”
“至于那黄纹貂，给你三十两。”
一旁的三个老学徒见此，不由都是露出羡慕之色。
他们虽然也参与围堵，但是只能分到五两，加起来还比不上陆沉一个人。
陆沉闻言，也不由露出喜色。
赤毛兔在异兽中价值较低，一般也就一百两出头，能分他二十两已经不少了，毕竟楚阔要拿大头，其他三个学徒也要分一点。
那黄纹貂倒是贵不少，因为此物皮毛极为坚固，配合一些珍奇材料，可以制作成防御力不弱的内甲。
“有了这笔钱，我总算可以光明正大的购买修炼资源了。”
陆沉心中低语，正准备开口道谢，突然听到一阵激烈的狂吠之声。
只见二黑看向远处，突然爆发出紧张的狂吠。
众人抬头看去，只见远处三头硕大黑狼猛冲而来。

“不好，是黑鳞狼。”
楚阔面色微变，当即开口说道：“发信号弹，我们只要坚持片刻，师兄就会过来。”
这边信号弹刚发出，那三头黑鳞狼就猛扑了过来。
陆沉面色微变，当即握住长枪，与众人靠在一起与黑鳞狼接战。
楚阔更是艺高人胆大，直接持刀扑了上去，欲要以一己之力拦住黑鳞狼。
可这三头黑鳞狼颇为聪明，居然没有选择与楚阔硬碰硬，仅留下最强一头与之纠缠，剩下两头向着四人扑了过来。
面对两大异兽的扑杀，四人根本不敌，仅仅一个照面就有一人被扑倒。
“麻烦了！”
陆沉心中微沉，正在思考如何不露痕迹出手。
而就在这个时候，一个老学徒猛地一把将陆沉向前推去，自己则借助滑雪板后方猛蹿而去。
“找死！”
陆沉心中一寒，眼中杀意沸腾。
而在这一刹那，那黑狼扑了上来，直取陆沉的咽喉。
危急时刻，陆沉架起长枪抵住对方撕咬，二黑趁此机会咬住对方后腿，让其吃痛之下甩开陆沉。
摆脱黑鳞狼的压制，陆沉迅速环顾四周，发现被扑倒的老学徒已经没了气息，另外一头黑鳞狼向着逃走的两人追了过去。
而楚阔虽强，但铁甲功速度一般，脚下滑雪板终究不够灵活，面对那头灵活的黑鳞狼似乎难以速战速决。
“不可在此地暴露。”
“二黑，走！”
content_en:
"Most of the strange beasts in this mountain are red-haired rabbits."
He complained, picked up the red-haired rabbit, and threw it to the old apprentice who came over.
Then he glanced at the skis under his feet and the big black dog not far away, and then said to Lu Chen: "The skis you studied are quite easy to use, and these two black men dared to chase the red rabbit, you have made a great contribution this time."
"If it weren't for my senior brother's archery skills, I wouldn't be able to catch this red-haired rabbit."
Lu Chen smiled and said modestly.
During this period, in order to hunt exotic beasts, Lu Chen took the time to make several skis.
The extremely fast speed of the skis gave them the speed to drive away the beasts, and Erhei also helped a lot.
Every time he went hunting, Erhei would drive the red-haired rabbit into an ambush circle, and then everyone would surround it with skis. Finally, Chu Kuo would kill him with an arrow.
Relying on this method, in just a few days, they hunted six strange beasts, including five red-haired rabbits and a yellow-striped marten. The total value was nearly a thousand taels of silver.
Chu Kuo was in a good mood, and then said: "Let's do this. Each of these red-haired rabbits will give you twenty taels of silver."
"As for the yellow-striped marten, I'll give you thirty taels."
The three old apprentices on the side couldn't help but look envious when they saw this.
Although they also participated in the siege, they could only get five taels, which combined was not as much as Lu Chen alone.
When Lu Chen heard this, he couldn't help but look happy.
The red-haired rabbit is of lower value among the exotic beasts, usually only a little over one hundred taels, so being able to share it with him for twenty taels is already a lot. After all, Chu Kuo wants to take the bulk, and the other three apprentices also have to share some.
The yellow-striped marten is quite expensive, because its fur is extremely strong, and with some rare materials, it can be made into inner armor with strong defense.
"With this money, I can finally purchase training resources openly."
Lu Chen whispered in his heart and was about to say thank you when he suddenly heard a fierce barking sound.
Erhei was seen looking into the distance and suddenly burst into nervous barks.
Everyone looked up and saw three huge black wolves charging towards them in the distance.
"No, it's a black-scaled wolf."
Chu Kuo's expression changed slightly, and he immediately said, "Send the flare. As long as we hold on for a moment, senior brother will come over."
As soon as the signal flare was sent out, the three black-scaled wolves pounced over.
Lu Chen's expression changed slightly, and he immediately grabbed the spear and leaned together with the others to fight the black-scaled wolf.
Chu Kuo was even more courageous as a skilled man, and he rushed forward with a knife, hoping to stop the black-scaled wolf by himself.
But these three black-scaled wolves were quite smart and did not choose to confront Chu Kuo head-on. Only the strongest one was left to struggle with it, and the remaining two pounced on the four of them.
Facing the attack of the two giant beasts, the four of them were completely invincible. One of them was knocked down in just one encounter.
"Trouble!"
Lu Chen's heart sank slightly, and he was thinking about how to take action without leaving any trace.
At this moment, an old apprentice suddenly pushed Lu Chen forward, and he jumped away with the help of the back of his skis.
"Seeking death!"
Lu Chen felt a chill in his heart, and his eyes boiled with murderous intent.
At this moment, the black wolf pounced forward and went straight for Lu Chen's throat.
At the critical moment, Lu Chen raised his spear to bite the opponent. Erhei took this opportunity to bite the opponent's hind leg, causing the opponent to shake off Lu Chen in pain.
After getting rid of the suppression of the black-scaled wolf, Lu Chen quickly looked around and found that the old apprentice who was knocked down had no breath. Another black-scaled wolf chased the two people who escaped.
Although Chu Kuo was strong, his armor speed was average, and the skis under his feet were not flexible enough. It seemed difficult to make a quick victory against the agile black-scaled wolf.
"Do not expose yourself here."
"Erhei, let's go!"
